name: Loft 14
blurb: Warm timber, plaster and soft light inside a converted warehouse.
body:
Warm timber, plaster and soft light inside a converted warehouse.

The brief for Loft 14 asked for a interiors project that responds to its setting in Lisbon, Portugal. We planned it around light, views and everyday movement, then built it with our own crews.

Materials were chosen to age well on site, and the same team stayed with the project from first sketch to handover in 2025.
